_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

card_product.name: IndiGo Axis Bank Credit Card
card_product.point_value_baseline_basis: IndiGo BluChips have no stated rupee value (re-checked 2026-11-07, W9). Axis T&C (IndiGo BluChip Program Specific Terms 1): "loyalty points and do not hold any monetary value", not legal tender, cannot be exchanged for cash; Axis T&C earn clause: "The bank has no role in determining the validity or the redemption value of the IndiGo BluChips". IndiGo membership terms: "IndiGo BluChips have no monetary refund value" and "The conversion rate for Cash + IndiGo BluChips may vary based on the origin, destination, flight schedule, flight number, date, season, fare, cabin, tier, sales channel". IndiGo FAQ: no monetary value, usable only to book IndiGo flights; the How to Burn page states no rate either. Redemption value per BluChip is not published and the Cash + BluChips conversion varies by route, date, fare and cabin. BluChips stay valid while the member is programme-active in the last 24 months (IndiGo FAQ); BluChip Vouchers last 6 months from issue.

eligibility_engine.notes: Axis page: primary cardholder 18 to 70, resident of India. Documents: PAN copy, proof of income (latest payslip, Form 16 or IT return), residence proof (driving licence, electricity bill or landline bill). The applicant must be, or be enrolled as, an IndiGo BluChip member using the same email and mobile number (T&C).

action.reason: Government services earn no BluChips (T&C excluded categories).
Utility services including telecom earn no BluChips.
Bridge fees, road fees and tolls earn no BluChips (T&C; the 28 Aug 2026 notice repeats this).
Gift cards earn no BluChips (the 28 Aug 2026 notice moves gift cards from the "Wallet" spend category to a separate "Gift Card" category, still excluded).

All EMI transaction types (loan on credit card, Dial an EMI, balance conversion and transfer, merchant EMI, balance on EMI) earn no BluChips; BluChips already earned are reversed on conversion, and credited back on EMI cancellation but not on foreclosure (T&C).
ATM cash withdrawals earn no BluChips.
Fees, charges and GST, and temporary credits or their reversals, earn no BluChips.

conditions.description: Airline MCC 4511 where the merchant name carries "Indigo" or "Interglobe" (IndiGo channels)

action.reason: 3 IndiGo BluChips per ₹100 on IndiGo channels (T&C Base and Accelerated earn); uncapped even on UPI.

Same 2 BluChips per ₹100 on grocery MCCs when paid through credit card on UPI, but earns from UPI are capped at 750 BluChips per statement month across base, grocery and dining; above the cap nothing is earned and the spend does not count toward milestones (T&C UPI Capping).
Same 2 BluChips per ₹100 on dining MCCs when paid through credit card on UPI, inside the shared 750 BluChip monthly UPI cap (T&C UPI Capping).
1 BluChip per ₹100 on other eligible spends when paid through credit card on UPI, inside the shared 750 BluChip monthly UPI cap; IndiGo channel spends are exempt from the cap (T&C UPI Capping).
2 IndiGo BluChips per ₹100 on grocery MCCs (T&C Base and Accelerated earn).
2 IndiGo BluChips per ₹100 on dining MCCs (T&C Base and Accelerated earn).
1 IndiGo BluChip per ₹100 on all eligible non-accelerated spends (T&C and Axis page).

dynamic_currency_conversion_dcc.trigger_condition: MITC: same markup on international transactions in Indian currency and on INR transactions with foreign-registered merchants. Notice effective 28 Aug 2026 revised the DCC markup from 1.5% to 3.5%.

category_surcharges.trigger_condition: 1% fee on each rental transaction, uncapped
1% once cumulative wallet loads reach ₹10,000 in a statement cycle (from 20 Dec 2024)
1% once cumulative fuel spend reaches ₹50,000 in a statement cycle (from 20 Dec 2024)
1% once cumulative utility payments reach ₹25,000 in a statement cycle (from 20 Dec 2024)

1% on each education payment made through third-party apps such as CRED, Paytm, Cheq and Mobikwik; direct school or college website or POS is exempt; DCC and international markup also apply to education transactions (from 20 Dec 2024)
1% once online skill-gaming spend reaches ₹10,000 in a statement cycle (MITC, all cards; not repeated on the IndiGo product pages)

components: MITC: sum of all instalments, all fees, interest or finance charges, taxes, any amount over the credit limit, and 2% of the remaining balance outstanding, subject to a minimum of ₹100; if the total amount due is below ₹100 the MAD equals it

annual_fee_waiver.evaluation_condition: No spend-based waiver: the MITC fee table lists ₹799 joining and ₹799 annual with no waiver condition, and the T&C bills the annual fee on the first statement after each anniversary year. Lifetime-free and first-year-free promotional cardholders get no welcome or renewal voucher.

welcome_and_renewal_gift.condition: Voucher worth 1,200 IndiGo BluChips on payment of the joining fee, and again each year on payment of the annual fee; issued to the BluChip account within 30 days, only if the fee is paid within 120 days of being charged; valid 6 months; not for add-on, lifetime-free or first-year-free cardholders (T&C 4). The rupee value is not stated.

open_questions: Value of one IndiGo BluChip in rupees: not stated by Axis or IndiGo (re-checked 2026-11-07, W9): Axis T&C say BluChips "do not hold any monetary value" and that "the bank has no role in determining the validity or the redemption value"; IndiGo's FAQ and membership terms say BluChips have no monetary value or refund value and the Cash + BluChips conversion varies by route, date, fare, cabin, tier and channel; the IndiGo How to Burn page gives no rate. point_value_inr_baseline and effective_base_return_percent are null.

Network (re-checked 2026-11-07, W9): resolved as two networks. The Axis press release of 18 Feb 2026 says the cards launch on RuPay and Visa; the Axis all-credit-cards listing shows base-card art with a RuPay Platinum mark; the product page caption and banner say Visa (banner art flagged "AI generated visual", VISA Signature mark, so the Visa tier is left N/A). Recorded as a dual-network card (RuPay Platinum and Visa); the base T&C UPI cap and the MITC credit-card-on-UPI clauses fit the RuPay variant. Not stated: whether the customer picks the network or gets one by default.

UPI: is_upi_linkable is true for the RuPay variant only (press release "UPI Advantage" on the base card, T&C UPI cap, MITC credit-card-on-UPI clauses cover Axis RuPay cards only, so the Visa variant is not modelled as UPI-linkable).

Fuel surcharge waiver: not stated. The MITC fuel row is 1% of the transaction amount; neither IndiGo card is named in the refunded list (₹400 to ₹4,000 and similar) or in the "refund not applicable" list, and the product page and T&C are silent.

MCC numbers behind the excluded categories (government, insurance, utility including telecom, rent, wallet, fuel, jewellery, tolls, gift cards) are not published; exclusions are category-level. Rounding mode and minimum transaction amount are not stated.

The 3 / 2 / 1 BluChips per ₹100 are card spend only. The headline "up to 19 IndiGo BluChips per ₹100" on the page banner is not a card rate: IndiGo's partner page splits the equivalent premium "up to 23" as 7 on card spends, 12 on IndiGo flights booked on IndiGo channels and 4 as a Blu 1 tier bonus, and the last two come from the BluChip programme, not from the card.
Maximum number of add-on cards is not stated (MITC add-on fee is nil; add-on holders get no separate welcome or annual voucher).

Promotional offers in the T&C (lifetime-free card with an activation voucher for applications 1 Sep to 31 Oct 2026; double welcome benefit for applications 1 Jun to 31 Aug 2026) have ended and are not modelled.

Both product pages show a banner that T&C "will be updated w.e.f. 28th August'26" (the base page names the Premium card by mistake); the revision notice was read and only changes DCC, the late fee above ₹50,000, payment allocation and gift card classification.
Interest-free period: the MITC gives a general 20 to 50 days for Axis cards, not a card-specific figure, so grace_period_days is null.
notes: IndiGo BluChips earned are credited by IndiGo within 30 working days of the statement date, computed on spends net of returns (T&C). Transactions converted to EMI are reversed.

Earn from credit-card-on-UPI spends is capped at 750 BluChips per statement month across base, grocery and dining earn (IndiGo channel spends are uncapped); the cap rule is written as zero accrual above 750 because the T&C says capped earns above 750 "shall not" earn and do not count toward milestones.

Milestone spends count net spends in the card anniversary year on eligible categories; vouchers are issued within 30 days after the next statement and only when that anniversary year's fee is paid; each is valid 6 months, redeemable against the base fare of an IndiGo flight (economy or Stretch).

Fees plus GST: joining ₹799 and annual ₹799 (T&C 3). Forex 3.5%, DCC 3.5%, rent 1%, cash advance 2.5% (minimum ₹500), cash payment at branch ₹175, over-limit 2.5% (minimum ₹500), returned payment 2% (minimum ₹500).
EMI conversion offered for transactions above ₹1,500 on request (page).
